selected_cell: Spectrolab XTJ Prime, beginning of life

source.scope: Cell-level manufacturer data, not R1 assembly measurements

reference_efficiency.basis: Production average over 100000 cells, BOL, AM0

solar_absorptivity.basis: Cell thermal parameter; temperature and angular dependence not supplied

ir_emissivity.basis: Cell emittance; not panel backside or effective assembly emittance

uncertainty_policy: null means not supplied, never zero uncertainty; no invented confidence intervals

assembly_requirements.cell_layout: Select exact cell size, count, packing, series/parallel strings and bypass diodes; nominal R1 1 m2 is not a cell layout
assembly_requirements.panel_stack: Select coverglass, adhesive, substrate and backing with thickness, mass and temperature-dependent heat capacity/conductivity
assembly_requirements.surface_finishes: Select front and rear surface finishes; obtain assembly absorptance/emittance versus temperature, angle and aging
assembly_requirements.mounting: Specify interface area, materials, fasteners, preload and contact-conductance test data
assembly_requirements.electrical: Obtain cold-temperature and low-irradiance I-V data, wiring losses and MPPT operating conditions
assembly_requirements.validation: Instrumented panel thermal-balance/vacuum test and model correlation with measured uncertainty

environment_requirements.terrain_temperature: Ingest versioned Diviner observations/products with footprint, quality flags and time coverage; statistics are not epoch temperatures
environment_requirements.radiative_geometry: Calculate terrain-to-panel view factors, mutual blockage, facet illumination and reflected/thermal incident flux
environment_requirements.material_response: Source terrain albedo/emissivity and thermophysical properties with resolution and uncertainty
environment_requirements.boundary_state: Solve mount/internal temperatures, dissipated loads, heaters and initial thermal history
